from: June book, night 1 (Where You Go, I Will Go)
p1: Long ago, there was no food in Bethlehem. So Naomi’s family moved far away, to a land called Moab.
In Moab, Naomi’s husband died. Her two sons married Ruth and Orpah. The sons died too. Naomi was sad and far from home.
Then Naomi heard the Lord had given food back home. She told Ruth and Orpah, “Go back to your mothers’ homes.” Orpah kissed Naomi and went home.
p2: But Ruth held on tight to Naomi. Ruth said, “Where you go, I will go. Your people will be my people, and your Heavenly Father my Heavenly Father.” So they walked to Bethlehem together.
Ruth stayed because she loved Naomi. Jesus stays close to you like that. Tonight, think of someone sad to stay close to.
old: Naomi lived far from home with her husband and two sons. Sadly, her husband died. Then both of her sons died too. Naomi felt very sad and alone.

Naomi’s daughter-in-law Ruth loved her very much. Naomi said, “You should go back to your family.” But Ruth said something beautiful: “Where you go, I will go. Your people will be my people. Your God will be my God.”
Ruth chose to stay with Naomi even though it was hard. They traveled together to a new land called Bethlehem. Ruth took care of Naomi because she loved her.
Ruth was loyal and kind. She didn’t leave Naomi when things got hard. Her love was stronger than her troubles.
